response:
FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

We see a jellyfish, its translucent body glowing in the sunlight, floating effortlessly through the water. Suddenly, a human, JASON, appears out of nowhere, a fishing net in hand. He scoops up the jellyfish and pulls it out of the water.

JASON
(to himself)
Ah, a beauty. I've never seen one like this before.

The jellyfish, now out of its element, begins to struggle and squirm in Jason's grasp.

JASON
(laughing)
Don't worry, little guy. I'm not going to hurt you.

Jason holds the jellyfish up to the sky, where a solar eclipse is about to occur. The jellyfish looks up, its tentacles quivering in confusion.

JASON
(to the jellyfish)
Behold, the eclipse. A rare and wondrous sight.

The jellyfish looks up at the sky, and its eyes widen in horror.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
Oh, the...the...abomination...

JASON
(confused)
What's wrong, little guy?

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...horrors beyond my comprehension...

JASON
(laughing)
What are you talking about?

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...void...the...abyss...

JASON
(getting concerned)
Okay, okay. I think you're just stressed out from being pulled out of the water.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
No...no...it's not just that. It's...it's...the...the...unseen...

JASON
(getting frustrated)
Unseen what?

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...things...that lurk...beyond...the...veil...

JASON
(skeptical)
Veil? What are you talking about?

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...thin...membrane...that separates...the...known...from...the...unknown...

JASON
(getting annoyed)
Look, I don't know what's going on with you, but I'm just going to put you back in the water.

JASON tries to release the jellyfish, but it resists, its tentacles wrapping around his arm.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
No...no...I...I...won't...let...go...

JASON
(getting scared)
Okay, okay. I'll let you go.

Jason slowly releases the jellyfish, and it floats away, its eyes still fixed on the sky.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...horrors...beyond...my...comprehension...

JASON
(shaking his head)
I don't know what's wrong with you, but I'm just going to go.

Jason walks away, leaving the jellyfish to its existential crisis.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

The jellyfish floats away, its tentacles still quivering with fear. It looks up at the sky, and its eyes widen in horror.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...void...the...abyss...

The jellyfish begins to descend into madness, its monologue growing more and more frantic.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...things...that lurk...beyond...the...veil...

The jellyfish's voice grows louder and more intense, until it's almost deafening.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
I...I...can't...bear...it...

The jellyfish's body begins to contort and twist, its tentacles flailing wildly.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
The...the...horrors...beyond...my...comprehension...

The jellyfish's monologue grows more and more incoherent, until it's nothing more than a series of inaudible whispers.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

The jellyfish is gone, consumed by its own madness. The water is calm and peaceful once again.

JASON
(to himself)
Well, that was weird.

Jason looks up at the sky, where the solar eclipse is still visible.

JASON
(to himself)
I guess some creatures are just too weird for this world.

FADE TO BLACK.
